title: SB2239 (2018 Regular): Imitation firearms; prohibit sale of.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Mississippi) (gun-policy Stage 5, Mississippi); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (Introduced; official copy, https://billstatus.ls.state.ms.us/documents/2018/html/SB/2200-2299/SB2239IN.htm)
provenance.note: Introduced text as filed; no passage vote. Borderline gun_policy call: the bill regulates look-alike devices, not real firearms. Section 1 also excludes collector replicas, air guns and small decorative items (not quoted).

operative_text:
Section 1 (Miss. Code § 45-10-1): "Imitation firearm" means a toy firearm, look-alike firearm, or other device having the appearance, shape or configuration of a firearm.
Section 2 (Miss. Code § 45-10-3): A person may not sell at retail, offer for retail sale or distribute for retail sale or promotion in this state a novelty lighter or imitation firearm. A person who violates this section commits a civil violation for which a fine of not more than Five Hundred Dollars ($500.00) may be imposed.
Section 3 (Miss. Code § 45-10-5(b)): To any imitation firearm that is used only in the theatrical, movie or television industry or by the drama department of a school.
